524: Begin with a box or bench 1-2 feet in front of you. Stand with your feet shoulder width apart. This will be your starting position.

526: Begin with a loaded barbell on boxes or stands of the desired height. A wide grip should be taken on the bar. The feet should be directly below the hips, with the feet turned out as needed. This will be the starting position.
528: Begin with a movement swinging your legs backward slightly.

530: Begin with a shoulder width, double overhand or hook grip, with the bar hanging just below the knees. Your back should be straight and inclined slightly forward.

532: Begin with a wide grip on the bar, with an overhand or hook grip. The feet should be directly below the hips with the feet turned out. 536: Begin with the feet in the pulling position, the bar racked across the back of the shoulders, and the hands placed in a wide snatch grip.

542: Bend at the knees, sitting down between your legs. Continue down until your hamstrings are on your calves. Keep your knees aligned with your feet by consciously using your abductors to push your knees out as you squat.

547: Bend both knees, keeping your back heel on the floor. Switch sides.

551: Bend knees slightly and bend over as you keep the natural arch of your back. Let the arms hang in front of you as they hold the bar. 552: Bend one knee and put that foot on the floor to stabilize the torso.

555: Bend the elbows of the arm holding the dumbbell so that it creates a 90-degree angle between the upper arm and the forearm. Tip: Keep the arm parallel to your torso.

560: Bend to one side with your arm over your head. You can hold onto the chair with your free hand.
561: Bend your back leg, while keeping the front one straight. Now raise the toes of your front foot off of the ground and lean forward.

563: Bend your knees and pull your upper thighs into your midsection as you breathe out. Continue this movement until your knees are near your chest. Hold the contracted position for a second.
564: Bend your knees slightly and bring your torso forward, by bending at the waist, while keeping the back straight until it is almost parallel to the floor. Make sure that you keep the head up.
565: Bend your knees slightly and bring your torso forward, by bending at the waist, while keeping the back straight until it is almost parallel to the floor. Tip: Make sure that you keep the head up.

567: Bend your knees slightly to keep them soft and springy.
568: Bend your left knee behind you and hold your left foot with your left hand. To stretch your hip flexor, press your left hip forward as you push your left foot back into your hand. Switch sides.

575: Bring down the weights slowly to your side as you breathe in. Keep full control of the dumbbell at all times. 582: Bring your feet, knees, and hips up to 90 degrees.

584: Bring your torso back around 30 degrees or so while creating a curvature on your lower back and sticking your chest out. This is your starting position.v

588: By using your thighs to help you get the dumbbells up, clean the dumbbells one arm at a time so that you can hold them in front of you at shoulder width. 593: Carefully return the weight to floor.

597: Catch the medicine ball with both hands and immediately throw it back to your partner.

621: Clean the kettlebell to your shoulder by extending through the legs and hips as you pull the kettlebell towards your shoulder. Rotate your wrist as you do so, so that the palm faces forward.
622: Clean the kettlebell to your shoulder. Clean the kettlebell to your shoulders by extending through the legs and hips as you raise the kettlebell towards your shoulder. The wrist should rotate as you do so.
623: Clean the kettlebell to your shoulders by extending through the legs and hips as you raise the kettlebell towards your shoulder. The wrist should rotate as you do so.
624: Clean the kettlebells to your shoulders by extending through the legs and hips as you pull the kettlebells towards your shoulders. Rotate your wrists as you do so, so that the palms face forward. This will be your starting position.
625: Clean the kettlebells to your shoulders by extending through the legs and hips as you raise the kettlebells towards your shoulders. Rotate your wrists as you do so.
626: Clean two kettlebells to your shoulders.
627: Clean two kettlebells to your shoulders. Clean the kettlebells to your shoulders by extending through the legs and hips as you pull the kettlebells towards your shoulders. Rotate your wrists as you do so.
628: Clean two kettlebells to your shoulders. Clean the kettlebells to your shoulders by extending through the legs and hips as you pull the kettlebells towards your shoulders. Rotate your wrists as you do so. This will be your starting position.

631: Clean two kettlebells two your shoulders.

650: Continue alternating in this manner until all prescribed repetitions are done.
651: Continue alternating sides in this manner until all prescribed repetitions are done.
652: Continue alternating the movement until the set is complete.

663: Continue shuffling back and forth across the box.

665: Continue the movement for the prescribed number of repetitions.

667: Continue this series of movements to failure.

673: Continue to push down as hard as you can with your lower back as you contract your abdominals and exhale.
